description: For any well-ordered index type and partial order P, a supplied function assigning a strict upper bound to each chain determines a strictly increasing map into P. Its value at each index is the supplied bound of the range of the earlier values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.increasing_map_of_chain_selector.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} [LinearOrder ι]
  [WellFoundedLT ι] [PartialOrder α] (next : Set α → α)
  (hnext : ∀ (C : Set α), IsChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) C → ∀ x ∈ C, x < next C) :
  ∃ f, StrictMono f ∧ ∀ (a : ι), f a = next (Set.range fun b => f ↑b)
